question: Should OpenClaw continue the Wave 2+ modular-dashboard roadmap as staged bundled dashboard work, and which subitems should instead move to plugin, skill, or ClawHub distribution?
rationale: The issue spans bundled UI, plugin SDK surface, persistent state, sandboxed widgets, command/data binding, install-from-URL, and visibility boundaries that automation cannot choose safely for maintainers.

options.title: Sponsor staged bundled dashboard work
options.body: Keep the tracker open, review linked PRs and subissues in dependency order, and require explicit storage, sandbox, permission, upgrade, and real-behavior proof before each stage lands.

options.title: Narrow to extension APIs
options.body: Keep only missing generic plugin/widget SDK seams in OpenClaw and ask optional widgets, galleries, skills, and app bundles to prove themselves through external plugin packages or ClawHub first.

options.title: Pause the roadmap
options.body: Do not sponsor bundled dashboard work in this cycle and close or defer the linked implementation stack after preserving useful design notes.

recommendation.title: Sponsor staged bundled dashboard work
recommendation.body: Keep the tracker open, review linked PRs and subissues in dependency order, and require explicit storage, sandbox, permission, upgrade, and real-behavior proof before each stage lands.

likelyOwner.reason: He authored and merged the current plugin-tab precedent that this roadmap explicitly builds on and is the strongest visible feature-routing owner signal.
